approval_note: 2026-09-08 corrective brief drafted at the maintainer's direction ('can you produce a corrective spec that supersedes the project and sets a course'). The central recommendation is to adopt Clearwing as the execution substrate rather than rebuild, and to contribute the web/logic detection path (taxonomy + IR candidate enumeration + obligation checker + a differential web oracle) that Clearwing's crash-oracle model does not reach. ; 2026-09-08 renamed execution-grounded-detection -> model-grounded-detection after the maintainer's correction: execution is not possible for all SAST targets and the bugs we own do not crash, so the arbiter is a program model built deterministically from code (IR candidate enumeration, binding-chain dataflow, obligation/guard-dominance) that checks LLM claims, producing a static evidence ladder (suspicion -> model_corroborated -> model_entailed); execution is a deferred tier for memory-safety-in-C only, adopted from Clearwing when a class needs it. ; 2026-09-08 requirements generated at the maintainer's direction ('write the requirements, and include to throw away broken parts. include the reduction of tests to what makes sense. I think there is an outgrowth problem here'): subtraction is Req 1-3 (remove the noise architecture, reduce 832 tests to surviving behavior, audit 99 modules for orphans) and precedes adoption of the Joern CPG arbiter (Req 4-8), the corpus as calibration set (Req 9), and the deferred Clearwing execution tier (Req 10).
